verdict.rationale: The docs cover pieces of the security posture but not in one place. Skills may bundle optional scripts, public plugins go through submission review with automated findings, the curated marketplace lists installation and authentication policies, and Sign in with ChatGPT shares only name, email and profile picture without granting data access or auto-approving actions. There is no consolidated security statement for skills. missing for 10: an explicit spec of what skill scripts can execute or how they are sandboxed, a documented trust model for unreviewed third-party or GitHub-URL skills, any telemetry or data-collection disclosure, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, the project documents its security posture — what skills can execute, the trust model for third-party skills, and any telemetry or data collection

citations.quote: A skill is a directory with a `SKILL.md` file plus optional scripts and references.
Submit the package you've already built as a ZIP, resolve automated findings, and submit it for review.
Signing in shares only your name, email address, and profile picture, when available, with the partner. It doesn't grant the plugin access to your data or approve actions automatically.
listing plugins with source paths and installation/authentication policies
